bias.zh: 看空 · 收复 $612，测试 10 日、100 日和 200 日均线

read.en: Meta rose 2.4% on Nov 3 to $621.03 on light volume, trading between $610.10 and $624.84. It is above the falling 5-day ($616.0) and below the falling 10-day ($632.0), 30-day ($698.6) and 200-day ($632.0) and the rising 100-day ($632.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($656.91), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: Meta 11月3日上涨 2.4%，收于 $621.03，成交清淡，盘中区间 $610.10–624.84。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$616.0）上方，位于下行的 10 日（$632.0）、30 日（$698.6）、200 日均线（$632.0）和上行的 100 日均线（$632.6）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$656.91），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $609.0–612.4 zone and the $615.8–621.7 band (5-day, Oct 27 low, Nov 2 high), both now support. Resistance is $624.8–626.4 (Nov 3 and Oct 30 highs), then $632.0–634.7 (10, 100 and 200-day, Oct 29 high) and $647.7–648.0. Support is $616.0–619.2, then $609.0–612.4 and $605.8–606.4. A close above $634.7 would target $648; below $609, $600–606.

s.en: Oct 28 low $609.0; Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows ($610.1); Aug 11 high $612.4, reclaimed
